answer: Every identity must buy a jade bond worth 40 POA at registration. It decays 5% each epoch and can only be redeemed after 20 epochs of honest work, so idle value melts away. A crystal-clear public ledger lists each bond and its owner, exposing clusters bought together. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA up front, most of it decaying before any reward arrives. At the zenith of payouts, an honest agent holds one bond and keeps the full yield.
